supersedes: reports/c2/C2_C3_READINESS.json, whose projection treated the 384 slots as 384 singleton calls. C3 is 12 batch requests of 32 objects.

projection.uncertainty: Derived from ONE observed batch. The range is a planning band, not a prediction, and a single observation supports no confidence interval.

free_tier_risk.observed_free_tier_behaviour: C2 measured roughly 20 requests per rolling multi-minute window for this model; 12 batch requests is far below the per-window request count that blocked the C2 pilot
free_tier_risk.request_count_risk: LOW relative to C2 - 12 requests instead of 384
free_tier_risk.token_and_output_risk: HIGHER PER REQUEST - each batch produces ~32x the output of a singleton call, so a per-minute TOKEN limit, not a request limit, becomes the plausible binding constraint
free_tier_risk.quota_snapshot: QUOTA_SNAPSHOT_NOT_PROGRAMMATICALLY_AVAILABLE - the Free Tier RPM/TPM/RPD limits for this project must be read from AI Studio before C3. No number was invented here.
free_tier_risk.billing: Free Tier only. Code never enables billing; a Paid Tier remains a user decision if C3 becomes genuinely blocked.
